notes.title: 《I Am Butter》 recently updated!
notes.content:
《I Am Butter》 is a VR platform game, many have loved since its beta version was launched, and we recently launched a new version！
We've fixed it for issues that occurred in previous betas!

- Optimized teaching levels and fixed the issue that English teaching levels could not be cleared
- The handle is optimized for ray and adapts to the handle of different devices
- Perspective optimization, second-level scene optimization
- Player guidance optimization, added animation guidance and text and voice guidance
- Added English subtitles

We hope the new version will bring more fun and enjoyment, and welcome everyone to the world of Butter!

-- Patha Pradipa

notes.title: The new version of "I Am Butter" is coming!!!
notes.content:
Hello, friends who love butter! The new version of I Am Butter is updated!

We have optimized it for the problems that appeared in the previous beta version!

1. Teaching level optimization

2. The controller ray is optimized, and the controller of different devices has been adapted

3. Angle of view optimization, second stage scene optimization

4. Player guidance optimization, adding animation guidance and text voice guidance

If you have any comments or suggestions,


—— Sincerely, Patha Pradipa

notes.title: 《I AM BUTTER VR》 new product launch discount
notes.content:
In order to thank the players for their support all the way, the latest work of Nuodeng people - "I'm butter VR" is on sale at 15% off within a limited time. 

Based on the preemptive version, New chapters’ DLC has been added in I Am Butter VR Full
Version,including the fast food kitchen in Chapter 2 and the butter factory in Chapter 3.The two new scenes will be several times larger than the first one.At the same time,various challenges are added in,such as new mechanisms, new puzzles.

The contents added in this DLC mainly include:
1.New chapters:the fast food kitchen & the butter factory.
2.Chapter scoring system.
3.Optimization of the support for game handle.
4.Optimization of others in the chapters.
